synopsis.text:
In The Black Bass you are an angular in a Black Bass fishing tournament. In this tournament, you start out on Lake Amanda as a rating C class angular in 200th position. You must find a good position on the lake to fish as the size, type (fish types: Black Bass, Brown Trout, Rainbow Trout, and Pike), quantity of fish, and obstacles vary depending on were you are on the lake. Once you selected your ideal location, you cast out the lure using a power meter and as you slowly reel it back in. You must try to attract the interested fish by wiggling the lure in the water and if the fish grabs the lure you must reel the fish back in making sure that the line does not snap as well as avoiding any obstacles in the way.

To help you have many lures to choose from (more been unlocked as you progress though the game) as well as a guide to tell you how good you currently selected location is. You have one day in game time to catch the biggest Black Bass you can find as at the end of the day the average weight of you caught Black Bass improves or reduces you rating as well overall position. Your rating determines how far you progress in the tournament unlocking new lakes (lakes: Lake Amada, Japan Lake, Lake More, San Lake).

The Black Bass est un jeu de pêche sur NES. Vous débutez votre carrière en bas de l'échelle et devrez progresser petit à petit vers les sommets de la discipline. Au fur à mesure de vos exploits, vous débloquerez du nouveau matériel et accéderez à de nouveaux coins de pêche. 5 catégories de poissons attendent de mordre à votre hameçon.

In The Black Bass nimmst du als Angler an einem Schwarzbarsch-Angelturnier teil. Bei diesem Turnier startest du auf dem Amandasee als Angler der Klasse C auf Platz 200. Du musst eine gute Position auf dem See zum Angeln finden, da Größe, Art (Fischarten: Schwarzbarsch, Bachforelle, Regenbogenforelle und Hecht), Anzahl der Fische und Hindernisse je nach Position auf dem See variieren. Sobald du den idealen Standort ausgewählt hast, wirf den Köder mit Hilfe eines Kraftmessers aus und ziehe ihn langsam wieder ein. Du musst versuchen, den interessierten Fisch anzulocken, indem du mit dem Köder im Wasser zappeln lässt. Wenn der Fisch den Köder schnappt, musst du ihn wieder einholen und dabei darauf achten, dass die Schnur nicht reißt und keine Hindernisse im Weg sind.

Juego de pesca en el que hay que capturar el máximo número posible de peces desde el atardecer al anochecer, pudiendo utilizar diferentes tipos de cebos para mejorar tus posibilidades, más allá de tus propios reflejos con la "caña".

In The Black Bass sei un angolare in un torneo di pesca Black Bass. In questo torneo, inizi sul Lago Amanda come angolare di classe C in 200a posizione. Devi trovare una buona posizione sul lago per pescare in quanto le dimensioni, il tipo (tipi di pesce: Black Bass, Trota fario, Trota iridea e Luccio), la quantità di pesce e gli ostacoli variano a seconda di dove ti trovi sul lago. Una volta selezionata la posizione ideale, scacci l'esca usando un misuratore di potenza e mentre la riavvolgi lentamente indietro. Devi cercare di attirare il pesce interessato agitando l'esca nell'acqua e se il pesce afferra l'esca devi avvolgere il pesce torna ad assicurarsi che la lenza non si spezzi oltre ad evitare eventuali ostacoli sul percorso.

O boato é verdade de que eles abrirão o Torneio Internacional de Pesca de Pescadores com 200 pescadores profissionais selecionados no seu NES. A sombra do peixe aparece das profundezas do lago. Este é um jogo de simulação real entre homem e peixe. O BLACK BASS torna realidade uma competição de sonhos de fantasia. O Black Bass vai pular e tentar se esconder no fundo das árvores nos quatro lagos diferentes. Agora o torneio está pronto para começar!
